'''Royal Antwerp Football Club''', commonly referred to as '''Royal Antwerp''' or simply '''Antwerp''', is a Belgian professional [[Association football|football]] club based in the city of [[Antwerp]]. The team competes in the [[Belgian Pro League]], the top tier of the [[Belgian football league system]]. Founded in 1880, it is the oldest football club in Belgium.

The club has won five [[List of Belgian football champions|Belgian league championships]] and four [[Belgian Cup]] titles, including a domestic [[Double (association football)|double]] in the [[2022–23 Royal Antwerp FC season|2022–23 season]]. In European competition, Antwerp reached the [[1993 European Cup Winners' Cup final|final]] of the [[1992–93 European Cup Winners' Cup|European Cup Winners' Cup]] in 1993 and qualified for the [[UEFA Champions League]] group stage for the first time in the [[2023–24 UEFA Champions League|2023–24 season]].

Antwerp's traditional kit colours are red and white. Since 1923, the club has played its home matches at the [[Bosuilstadion]], located in the [[Deurne, Belgium|Deurne]] district of Antwerp."}}
